config.label: JSON array of `{ baseUrl, authToken? | authUsername?+authPassword? }` entries — one per ntfy server
config.description: JSON array of `{ baseUrl, authToken? | authUsername?+authPassword? }` entries — one per ntfy server. First entry is the default base. Auth is scoped to the entry's `baseUrl`; per-call `base_url` overrides that match a registered base forward that server's auth. Takes precedence over the single-server NTFY_BASE_URL / NTFY_AUTH_* shorthand.

config.label: Single-server shorthand — base URL of the ntfy server (no trailing slash)
config.description: Single-server shorthand — base URL of the ntfy server (no trailing slash). Used when NTFY_SERVERS is unset.

config.label: Topic used when a tool call omits `topic`
config.description: Topic used when a tool call omits `topic`. Treat the topic name as a secret — anyone who knows it can publish or subscribe.

config.label: Bearer access token (`tk_…`) for the single-server shorthand
config.description: Bearer access token (`tk_…`) for the single-server shorthand. Mutually exclusive with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME / NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD.

config.label: Basic-auth username for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD
config.description: Basic-auth username for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD.

config.label: Basic-auth password for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME
config.description: Basic-auth password for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME.

config.label: Max retry attempts for transient upstream failures (5xx, network, 429)
config.description: Max retry attempts for transient upstream failures (5xx, network, 429).

config.label: When true, a per-call `base_url` override must resolve to a public address and its redirects are not followed
config.description: When true, a per-call `base_url` override must resolve to a public address and its redirects are not followed. Servers registered under NTFY_SERVERS / NTFY_BASE_URL are exempt. Turn it on where callers you do not control can reach the server.

config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

config.label: Directory for file-based logs (Node only; ignored on Workers)
config.description: Directory for file-based logs (Node only; ignored on Workers).

config.label: Enable OpenTelemetry instrumentation (spans, metrics, completion logs)
config.description: Enable OpenTelemetry instrumentation (spans, metrics, completion logs).
